key_insight: GeoReplay preserves pretrained vehicle-aerodynamics knowledge while matching standard fine-tuning accuracy on new target datasets.
engineering_relevance: Geometry- and gradient-aligned replay can help adapt aerodynamic surrogates to new vehicle classes without sacrificing accuracy on previously learned designs.
method: Benchmark five DrivAerML-pretrained surrogates on four independent target datasets.
Replay source simulations geometrically similar to the target, applying updates only when their gradients agree with the target gradient.
Separate geometric coverage from simulated-physics differences in a risk bound and prove target-objective descent for sufficiently small GeoReplay steps.
evidence_signal: Across datasets differing in geometry, CFD solver, turbulence model, and flow conditions, fine-tuning beats training from scratch in fewer than half of comparisons; GeoReplay reduces source error relative to fine-tuning in 77 of 80 settings while matching target accuracy.
watch_item: The descent guarantee concerns the target training objective, not unseen-case accuracy; deployment still requires validation under new geometries and physics conditions.
paper_title: Measuring and Improving Transfer of Neural Surrogates for Vehicle Aerodynamics
